checks: search_logs for KV cache allocation failures
correlate_events to line alerts and errors up in time
common_causes: KV cache exhaustion forcing tiny batches
max_num_seqs set too low so the GPU is underutilised
speculative decoding with a low draft acceptance rate
remediation: Free KV headroom (raise kv_cache_gb or lower max_num_seqs), then re-tune batch size; verify tok/s recovers before closing.
symptoms: inference tok/s far below the expected rate for the model
title: LLM inference throughput collapse

checks: search_logs for CRC errors and link-down events
correlate_events across the same interface and window
common_causes: degraded or faulty optic on the link
congestion on the uplink during a burst
remediation: Drain the link, replace the optic or reseat the cable, then watch CRC counters for 30 minutes before returning it to service.
symptoms: packet loss above 1 percent on a link
title: Packet loss on a leaf-spine link

checks: search_logs for scheduler and batching warnings
common_causes: max_num_seqs or batch size set too low
requests too small to fill a batch
remediation: Raise max_num_seqs and batch size until GPU util and tok/s both rise; if the queue still grows, add a replica.
symptoms: inference tok/s well below the expected rate
title: GPU underutilised while request queue grows

checks: query_metrics for kv_cache_usage_pct against context length
throughput diagnostic with observed batch size
common_causes: KV cache budget too small for the context window
no prefix caching for repeated system prompts
fragmentation from mixed short and long sequences
remediation: Enable prefix caching, size the KV cache for the p95 context length, and consider chunked prefill for very long prompts.
symptoms: throughput drops as context length grows
cache evictions in the serving logs
title: KV cache tuning for long-context serving

checks: correlate_events to group alerts and errors by device and time
check_alerts per device to find the earliest firing alert
search_logs for the first ERROR in the window
common_causes: one root cause cascading into many alerts
thresholds set too tight after a deploy
a flap storm on a single link
remediation: Find the earliest correlated event, investigate that device first, and silence downstream alerts until the root cause is confirmed.
symptoms: many alerts firing at once across devices
unclear which alert is the root cause
paging noise drowning the real signal
title: Alert storm triage
